services_title: What I can do for you
services_description: Practical help tailored to the local community in Dordogne
svc_declutter_summary: Create tidy spaces, trips to the tip with a trailer, help with sorting out
svc_declutter_detail:
• I can create efficient storage, help you to sort out what is important for you to keep, what can be going to the recyclerie or to the tip and what can be sold
  • I can give you the extra motivation you need to get started on the project that you have been putting off for a while
svc_grocery_summary: Handle the grocery run, other errands and transportation
svc_grocery_detail:
• I can shop, pack and deliver groceries, with or without you, from the supermarkets or weekly fresh produce markets
  • I can run your errands, help you with mundane tasks
  • I can drive you to where you need to be, airport, train stations, shopping centres, doctor's appointments
svc_outings_summary: Join you for outings, translating and guiding
svc_outings_detail:
• I can be a French-speaking companion for trips you wish to take
  • I can be a personal guide to your friends visiting from abroad, taking them to Perigord Noir or Bordeaux/Cognac vineyards for instance
  • with whom you have a cup of tea
svc_relocation_summary: Help prepare your relocation whether locally or internationally
svc_relocation_detail:
• I can help you with your property search
  • I can help you with the sorting, packing/unpacking, choosing a removalist, contact utilities providers and getting all the paperwork sorted
  • I can clean the house prior to sale or prior to moving in
svc_pet_summary: Looking after your pet in your home environment while you are away
svc_pet_detail:
• I can keep them company, take them for walks and play with them
  • I can look after them as if they were my own and send you pictures and videos
svc_medical_summary: Find doctors and specialists, make appointments, translate
svc_medical_detail:
• I can research and call doctors or specialists to make an appointment
  • I can translate during your appointment with the medical professional if required
  • I can drive you to appointments
  • I can help with Ameli and insurance
  • I can assist you in any way you need during your recovery
svc_home_summary: Assist with every day home tasks and look after your property when you are away
svc_home_detail:
• I can perform light household chores
  • I can look after your house while you are away
  • I can get quotes and coordinate with local tradesmen
  • I can help you turn around your gite for new guests
  • I can manage the gite if you are away
svc_french_summary: Offer French conversation practice and help with forms, procedures and translation
svc_french_detail:
• I can help you improve your French conversation and build up your confidence to interact with the local community
  • I can assist with filling out the forms and paperwork
  • I can translate documents

Please note, I am not a specialist on Carte de Sejour. I can help to a degree but I do not offer a service to do the procedure for you.
svc_custom_summary: Other assistance services tailored to your specific needs
svc_custom_detail:
• I can do (almost) anything else you can think about
  • My aim is to alleviate the hurdles and make your life here more enjoyable
about_text_1:
After 22 years living abroad in the UK, Morocco, Sri Lanka, Japan, Thailand and Australia, I moved back to France where I grew up.
And I had to start from scratch. I have missed the cheese and the wine but I have not missed the complexity of the system.
about_text_2: Knowing the excitement of a new start, I am also familiar with the exhaustion that comes with facing the challenges of a new life.
about_text_3:
So I have a clear mission : to help the English-speaking community navigate the beautiful but often complicated French way of life.
I decided to launch Pauline Service because I wanted my work to make sense. I genuinely like people and want to help.
I'm not just a service provider; I'm a member of this community here to make my neighbours' life easier.
about_text_4:
I believe in flexibility, not just in my schedule, but in my rates.
Because every situation is unique, I offer flexible rates and tailor-made support to fit your specific project and budget.
about_text_5: I believe in meaningful work that supports our local community and I'll always do it with the same energy and empathy.
about_text_6: So please, don't hesitate to contact me to have a look together at how I could help.
who_newcomers_text_1: Let me handle the frustration of 'red tape', the lack of clarity on who to call and where to start, the endless lunch breaks and public holidays of bureaucracy.
who_newcomers_text_2: Let me help you to settle and make yourselves truly at home.
who_established_title: For the ones already established here:
who_established_text_1: Most of you have been in France for years or even decades and as we are all aging, we realise we may need to scale back.
who_established_text_2: I specialise in decluttering and organising your space, prepping your next move or the next chapter of your life.
who_established_text_3: Need a ride to Limoges, Angouleme or Perigueux? A translator for an appointment? Or just someone to get things done?
who_established_text_4: My services are as flexible as your needs.
testimonials_description: See what our clients have to say about our personal assistance services.
testimonial_1_text: Pauline was a lifesaver when dealing with my property purchase in Dordogne. Her knowledge of both languages and local procedures made everything so much easier.
testimonial_2_text: As new residents in Nontron, we were overwhelmed with the paperwork. Pauline guided us through every step with patience and expertise.
testimonial_3_text: I couldn't have navigated the French healthcare system without Pauline's help. She arranged all my appointments and even accompanied me when needed.
testimonial_4_text: Pauline looks after our holiday home when we're away. Her attention to detail and reliability give us complete peace of mind.

privacy_content:
1. Introduction

This privacy policy aims to inform users of the website paulineservice.com about how their personal data may be collected and processed, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act (Informatique et Libertés).

We place great importance on the protection of your privacy. No personal data is collected without your knowledge, and we do not use any cookies or trackers on this website.

2. Data Collected and Purposes

Our website does not use cookies and does not collect any browsing data.

The only data that may be collected are those you voluntarily provide to us through:

  • The contact form,
  • Direct email,
  • Phone communication.

These data are used exclusively to:

  • Respond to your requests,
  • Ensure the follow-up of our business relationship (if applicable),
  • Fulfill our legal and regulatory obligations.

3. Legal Basis for Processing

The processing of your data is based on:

  • Your consent (e.g. when sending us a message via the contact form or by email),
  • The performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures (if you become a client),
  • Legal obligations (e.g. retention of invoices for accounting purposes).

4. Data Retention Period

Your data are only kept for as long as necessary to achieve the purposes for which they were collected:

  • Information requests: up to 3 years after the last contact,
  • Client data: for the duration of the contractual relationship, then archived in accordance with legal requirements (particularly accounting obligations).

5. Data Sharing

Your data are never sold or transferred to third parties nor shared with any parties.

6. Data Security

We implement all appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against loss, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

7. Your Rights

In accordance with the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act, you have the following rights:

  • Right of access, rectification, update, and erasure of your data,
  • Right to restrict processing,
  • Right to object to processing,
  • Right to data portability.

To exercise your rights, please contact us using the contact form on our homepage.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés): www.cnil.fr.

8. Changes to this Policy

We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time in order to remain compliant with legal and regulatory developments. The applicable version is the one published on the website.
